alpha_mixed_version_conditions.condition_binding: Each row retains exact source packet, version and contract SHA; device/SN/energy/angle must equal verified source_conditions
alpha_mixed_version_conditions.energy_definition: MeV at the first modeled Si surface, with no preceding stack propagation
alpha_mixed_version_conditions.geometry_rule: Each packet must independently validate its original input model and exact analytic Si mask
alpha_mixed_version_conditions.origin_change: A changed anchor, epoch or unit convention requires a separately registered compatible model contract; this list does not admit it
alpha_mixed_version_conditions.source_angle_definition: degrees from +z in x-z plane, phi=180 degrees

common_semantics.charge: Electronic generation charge in fC, one elementary charge per electron-hole pair
common_semantics.domain: Exact prescribed finite Si material mask and all time; no tail renormalization
common_semantics.normalization: Raw charge-weighted moments; never divide feature columns by Q
common_semantics.origin_rule: Prescribed input source anchor and epoch, never measured centroid, TCAD field or accepted clock
common_semantics.source_present: Explicit positive source=1; verified explicit absent source=0 only if that version supports it; missing/failed input rejects
common_semantics.structural_zero: All 13 raw features zero and explanatory moments null; no measured-native-zero claim

comparison_evidence.interpretation: Existing input-only normal-incidence comparison; not native proof and not a new tolerance

excluded_inferences: The two source generators are not byte-identical or physically calibrated equivalents.
v1 Z/H/split remain version-specific qualification inputs; this compatibility does not make v2 accept them.
No v2 proton implementation, structural-zero builder, native BE/HeavyIon/endpoint qualification or PMI/R12 repair is implied.
No holdout relabeling, training authorization, response reuse, population risk or energy-angle-only stochastic prediction is implied.
required_downstream_checks: Explicit compatible contract list in data design; retain the existing rejection of unlisted or mixed-semantic contracts.
Recompute every packet with its own registered immutable verifier; never regenerate or relabel a v1 packet as v2.
Matching response/circuit/physics, actual source/native qualification, same-event two-bit A0 controls, and frozen final holdouts remain required.
